title: St. Martin de Porres, Religious
subtitle: Optional Memorial · Phil 2:5-11; Ps 22; Lk 14:15-24
text: St. Martin de Porres (1579-1639), son of a Spaniard and a freed Black woman in Lima, entered the Dominicans as a lowly helper and became a lay brother. He swept floors, nursed the sick, and fed the poor of the city. Like Christ in today's reading from Philippians, he "emptied himself" and served.
imageAlt: St. Martin de Porres in a white Dominican habit and black cape rises on clouds with arms open, gazing upward, surrounded by angels, one holding lilies, in a gilded frame.
